page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. With a single thread per core configuration, the instance provides dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.32xlarge offers a high density of memory relative to its dedicated CPU allocation, making it suitable for enterprise-scale workloads that require substantial RAM without the overhead of shared-core architectures. This hardware profile is designed for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, heavy data processing pipelines, and memory-intensive analytics workloads.
